namespaces.description: One entry per Kubernetes namespace: who may talk to which port.

team.description: Owning team; becomes the label linkerd-policies/team on every generated resource.

allowSameNamespace.description: true: every meshed workload in this namespace may call every declared port of this namespace. false (default): even neighbours need connectsTo.

workloads.description: One entry per Deployment/StatefulSet. The key is the workload name and, by default, its ServiceAccount and app.kubernetes.io/name pod label.

ports.description: Every port the pods listen on. Each becomes a deny-by-default Linkerd Server.

publish.description: Port names other namespaces may request in their connectsTo. Everything else stays private to this namespace.

connectsTo.description: Ports this workload needs to reach, as <namespace>/<workload>/<port>.

serviceAccount.description: Only when the pods do not run as a ServiceAccount named like the workload.

podLabels.description: Only when the pods are not labelled app.kubernetes.io/name: <workload>.

protocol.description: How Linkerd treats the traffic. Use opaque for non-HTTP protocols (databases, AMQP, Kafka...).
